scientific_question: Can the dense teacher's layer-private MLP functions be represented by one shared full-width ridge dictionary plus signed layer-specific atom selection, or does the endpoint require a small number of genuinely private nonlinear ridge atoms per layer?

causal_basis.paired_factorial_finding: Both one-sided substitutions fail and the pair has a -3.4708 CE compensatory interaction, so c_fc feature boundaries and c_proj residual writes must be treated as complete paired nonlinear atoms.
causal_basis.kronecker_finding: A healthy layer-private paired Kronecker fit at 22.15x recovers only 0.5376 mean output energy, 0.0194 mean input-JVP energy, and leaves +4.1768 fixed CE. Matrix-factorization-only families are closed.
causal_basis.shared_trunk_finding: One learned shared full-rank trunk improves paired Monarch by 0.2412 CE but remains +0.2053 behind attention-only, proving reusable directions exist but one common function is insufficient.
causal_basis.gain_control: Earlier c_proj endpoint attribution found generic gains alone null while hidden rotations were causal. Therefore the signed post-GELU gain is only a nested diagnostic of atom reuse; it is not independently promoted without passing output, JVP, and CE gates.
causal_basis.nonlinear_dictionary_control: The prior sparse-MoE learned nonlinear dictionary tested a strict approximately 200x complete-expert budget without a learned shared dense trunk. This plan instead asks a relaxed dense-MLP boundary question at 5.95-11.79x and includes a strong learned shared function.
causal_basis.novel_mechanism: The private branch adds complete nonlinear ridge atoms V_l GELU(U_l x+b_l). Unlike LoRA, Kronecker, Monarch, BlockFHT, or a post-residual FC, it changes both GELU activation hyperplanes and their coupled residual-write directions.

family.equation: F_l(x) = D_out,l [ W_proj diag(q_l) GELU(diag(p_l) W_fc x) + V_l GELU(U_l x + b_l) ]
family.shared_state: One learned W_fc and W_proj are shared by all layers. Every layer owns signed pre-GELU p_l, signed post-GELU q_l, and positive residual-output D_out,l coordinates.
family.private_state: At private width m, every layer owns U_l in R^(m by 768), b_l in R^m, and V_l in R^(768 by m). Width zero omits the private arm.
family.inference_note: The private arm runs directly as two small GEMMs; it requires no generated dense weight, dense temporal error buffer, or expansion kernel. The shared 3072-wide trunk is materialized once and reused by all layers.

fit_protocol.optimizer: Adam over every counted family parameter
fit_protocol.initialization: Width zero starts from the sealed trained one-trunk checkpoint and adds identity signed post-GELU gains. Width 128 warm-starts the fitted width-zero state with Normal(0,0.02) U, zero b, and zero V. Width 256 preserves the fitted width-128 atoms and appends 128 atoms with the same deterministic zero-output initialization.
fit_protocol.nesting_rule: All widths are one monotone capacity path, not independent hyperparameter trials. No width, seed, learning-rate, optimizer, or restart is selected on heldout data.
fit_protocol.objective: Equal-layer/equal-bank normalized MSE on the dense teacher function at clean teacher/candidate state banks and symmetric 1-percent RMS input perturbations.
fit_protocol.parameter_clamps: Signed pre/post-GELU gains are clamped to [-4,4]; residual-output log gains are clamped to [-4,4]. Private U, V, and b are not clamped.

report: fit and holdout objective by nested width
heldout output recovery by layer and state bank
heldout analytic input-JVP recovery by layer and state bank
parameter, direct-FLOP, peak-memory, and wall-time accounting

frozen_gates.optimization_healthy: The stage is finite and either ends at normalized fit objective <=0.5 or reduces its initial objective by at least 25 percent. The width-256 family is rejected only if this health gate passes.

decision_rule.width0_pass: The common learned ridge dictionary is sufficient once layers receive signed post-GELU atom coefficients. Implement and MFU-gate only this 11.79x family.
decision_rule.width128_pass: Layer-private nonlinear atoms are required but 128 per layer suffice. Implement and MFU-gate only this 7.91x family.
decision_rule.width256_only_pass: The endpoint boundary lies between 5.95x and 7.91x. Report the cost before one production verification; do not pretend this meets the original 200-500x claim.
decision_rule.width256_fail: Reject one shared full-width trunk plus up to 256 private ridge atoms per layer. Do not sweep width, seed, optimizer, or LR; use the residual decomposition to derive a different sharing topology.
decision_rule.optimization_inconclusive: Permit only offline optimizer-geometry repair of this exact oracle; do not infer representational failure or launch LM training.

authorization.allowed: Implement and run one exact fixed-teacher nested-width oracle after tests and a measured runtime/VRAM preflight.
not_allowed: width, seed, learning-rate, optimizer, activation, or regularizer sweeps
using heldout recovery to alter the nested path
authorization.callback_policy: Foreground-poll if the measured complete protocol is at most five minutes; otherwise launch one verified @Codex watchdog with terminal/failure callbacks and the standard action prompt.
